inputs.text: Vertical medium shot in the same apartment study. The same adult Chinese woman age 28 sits safely at the wooden desk, smartphone placed face-up and inactive. Her hands are lowering from her face after a deep relieved breath and she looks directly toward camera with calm gratitude and renewed clarity.
